issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
covered_actors: Industry stakeholders and private-sector standards development organizations
Organizations designing, developing, deploying, or using AI systems

evidence.quote: Incorporation of the AI RMF in international standards will further the Framework’s value as a resource to those designing, developing, deploying, or using AI systems to help manage the many risks of AI and promote trustworthy and responsible development and use of AI systems.
evidence.source_section: Encouraging International Standards Incorporation of the AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

evidence.quote: The AI RMF seeks to “Take advantage of and foster greater awareness of existing standards, guidelines, best practices, methodologies, and tools for managing AI risks....”
evidence.source_section: Encouraging International Standards Incorporation of the AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

evidence.quote: These drafts then will be submitted into the private sector-led standardization process as proposals for further development into voluntary consensus standards.
evidence.source_section: NIST’s AI Standards “Zero Drafts” Pilot Project

evidence.quote: The goal is to drive the development and implementation of AI-related consensus standards, cooperation and coordination, and information sharing.

enforcement_authorities: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
Interagency Committee on Standards Policy (ICSP) AI Standards Coordination Working Group (AISCWG)
implementation_notes: Official NIST ITL AI Program standards page (originally published 2021-08-03 and updated through March 6, 2026). Describes NIST's non-regulatory standards strategy: the AI Standards Zero Drafts pilot, A Plan for Global Engagement on AI Standards (NIST AI 100-5e2025, July 26, 2024), federal interagency coordination via ICSP/AISCWG, alignment of AI RMF 1.0 with international ISO/IEC standards and crosswalks, and GCR-26-069 (Jan 15, 2026) on evaluating AI standards development.
